title: The Contact of Kowloon Revisited
author: Petra Halloran
blurb: Bram Almeida, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
